company.name: Tesla, Inc.
company.industry: Electric Vehicles / Energy Storage / AI (FSD, robotics) - Manufacturing-Tech Hybrid
company.primary_assets: Gigafactory Manufacturing Equipment, Tooling, Buildings, Computer Equipment/AI Training Hardware, Solar Energy Systems, Operating Lease Vehicles
company.coverage_note: Tesla FY2022（2022-01-01至2022-12-31），审计报告日期2023-01-31。无折旧年限变更。关键事件：收入$81.5B（+51%），CAPEX$7.16B，净利润$12.6B。2022年11月宣布裁员约11,000人；Q3起设施整合+数据中心战略转向；全年重组费用$4.61B。为TSLA 2023的"变更前一年"锚点。

financial_highlights.capex_note: Purchases of property and equipment $7,158M (MD&A: "Capital expenditures amounted to $7.16 billion in 2022, compared to $6.52 billion in 2021.")
financial_highlights.depreciation_expense_note: Depreciation expense ~$2,440M (approx, from Note 8 PP&E schedule)
financial_highlights.ppe_net_note: Property, plant and equipment, net $23,548M (2022) vs $17,549M (2021)

accounting_policy.depreciation_method: straight-line (generally); units-of-production for Panasonic production equipment under finance lease
accounting_policy.leasehold_improvements: shorter of estimated useful life or related lease term
accounting_policy.change_in_estimate: None disclosed for fiscal 2022. No useful-life revision for any asset class.
accounting_policy.impairment_policy: Long-lived assets reviewed whenever events or changes in circumstances indicate carrying amount may not be recoverable; recoverability measured against future undiscounted cash flows; impairment measured as excess of carrying value over fair value.
accounting_policy.policy_risk_note: Tesla 2022年未变更任何资产类别折旧年限。与2023年相同：machinery 3-15年、computer equipment 3-10年的宽区间披露给予管理层不透明裁量空间。减值政策采用未折现现金流测试（弱兜底）。Panasonic设备按产量法折旧是唯一的相对保守项。

risk_signals.keyword_matched: early obsolescence of our manufacturing equipment
risk_signals.text_excerpt: We may be negatively impacted by any early obsolescence of our manufacturing equipment. We depreciate the cost of our manufacturing equipment over their expected useful lives. However, product cycles or manufacturing technology may change periodically, and we may decide to update our products or manufacturing processes more quickly than expected.
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: Same explicit acknowledgment as 2023: manufacturing equipment may become obsolete before end of 3-15 year accounting life. In 2022, this was particularly relevant as Tesla was transitioning to 4680 cells, new casting processes, and next-gen platforms.
evidence_chain: Tesla admits product cycles may change faster than expected
2022 context: 4680 cell ramp, structural battery pack, mega-casting
Early retirement shortens useful life → depreciation accelerated
Result: current depreciation embeds optimistic "no early retirement" assumption

risk_signals.source: Note 2. Summary of Significant Accounting Policies
risk_signals.keyword_matched: Machinery, equipment, vehicles and office furniture 3 to 15 years
risk_signals.text_excerpt: Depreciation is generally computed using the straight-line method over the estimated useful lives of the respective assets, as follows: Machinery, equipment, vehicles and office furniture 3 to 15 years. Tooling 4 to 7 years. Building and building improvements 15 to 30 years. Computer equipment and software 3 to 10 years.
risk_signals.page_location: Note 2. Summary of Significant Accounting Policies
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: Same depreciation schedule as 2023. Machinery 3-15 years and computer equipment 3-10 years are the widest ranges in the sample. In 2022, computer equipment gross was $2,072M (vs $3,799M in 2023), so the AI compute depreciation mismatch was smaller in absolute terms but the percentage mismatch was identical.
evidence_chain: Machinery/equipment range: 3-15 years; computer equipment: 3-10 years
Mismatch ratio: up to 5-10x for AI compute
Result: even at smaller scale, the mismatch structure is identical to 2023

risk_signals.source: Item 1. Business + Note 8. Property, Plant and Equipment
risk_signals.text_excerpt: We are also developing additional computer hardware to better enable the massive amounts of field data captured by our vehicles to continually train and improve these neural networks.
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: Tesla's AI training compute asset base was $2,072M gross in 2022 (vs $3,799M in 2023). These assets depreciated within the 3-10 year class face the same 1-2 year economic obsolescence cycle. The 2022 10-K is the first to mention "additional computer hardware" for FSD training.
evidence_chain: Item 1: Tesla building AI training computer hardware
Result: if depreciated over 5-7 years, annual expense materially understated

risk_signals.text_excerpt: For the years ended December 31, 2022, 2021 and 2020, we have recognized no material impairments of our long-lived assets.
risk_signals.page_location: Note 2. Long-Lived Assets Including Acquired Intangible Assets
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: Tesla reported zero material impairments in 2020-2022. This is consistent with the company's growth trajectory, but the undiscounted cash flow impairment test is a weak safeguard.
evidence_chain: Impairment test: undiscounted cash flows (weak threshold)
Growth trajectory makes test easy to pass
Result: low current impairment risk, but weak downside protection

dimension_scores.dimension_name: 折旧年限 vs 技术实际寿命
dimension_scores.dimension_name_en: Depreciation Life vs Technology Useful Life
dimension_scores.reasoning: 与2023年相同的折旧年限结构：machinery 3-15年、computer equipment 3-10年。AI训练硬件错配比例相同（5-10x），但2022年绝对规模较小（$2,072M vs $3,799M）。制造设备方面，2022年处于4680电池和新一代平台开发初期，提前淘汰风险略低于2023年（Cybertruck量产年）。评4分（与2023年锚点一致）。
2022年无任何折旧年限变更（与2023年一致）。落在锚点"无变更→3"档。评3分（与2023年锚点一致）。
2020-2022连续三年零重大减值。2022年特斯拉仍处于高速增长期，减值测试容易通过。但2022年11月裁员11,000人和重组费用$4.61B是未来减值风险的前兆。评2分（与2023年锚点一致）。
2022年电动车竞争加剧：比亚迪销量超越特斯拉、传统车企电动化加速。价格战尚未全面爆发（2023年才是价格战年），但竞争压力已在积累。AI/FSD方面，HW3→HW4的过渡正在进行。评4分（与2023年锚点一致）。

composite_score.confidence_reason: Based on TSLA 2023 confirmed annotation, with 2022-specific financial data from 10-K. The risk structure is identical to 2023 (same depreciation schedule, same Risk Factor language), with smaller absolute scale for AI compute assets.

comparative_context.same_company_trend: TSLA 2022 (no change) → 2023 (no change). Both years share identical depreciation policies and Risk Factor language. The main difference is scale: AI compute assets grew from $2,072M to $3,799M (+83%), and CAPEX grew from $7.16B to $8.90B (+24%).
comparative_context.cross_company_benchmark: Tesla's manufacturing-focused depreciation (3-15 years machinery) differs from cloud vendors (4-6 years servers). The risk profile is "manufacturing obsolescence" rather than "data center refresh cycle".
comparative_context.narrative_significance: Tesla 2022 serves as the "pre-Cybertruck" baseline — before the full manufacturing complexity of multiple vehicle platforms (Model 3/Y, Cybertruck, Semi) stretched the depreciation assumptions.

annotation_methodology.source_document: Tesla, Inc. 2023 Annual Report on Form 10-K (CIK 0001318605, document tsla-20231231)
annotation_methodology.text_extraction_method: Source HTML is a Workiva inline-XBRL document compressed into ~4 super-long lines, so line-number citation is unusable. Text extracted via Python regex tag-stripping + HTML entity unescaping into a plain-text working copy, then sentence-wrapped (newline after sentence terminators) for grep-based keyword search (-i): useful life/lives, depreciation, impairment, obsolescence, prospectively, change in estimate, Dojo, tooling, price reductions, capital expenditures. All locations cited as 'section name + short verbatim locator string' instead of line numbers. All quoted excerpts verified verbatim against the extracted body text; XBRL header/hidden-tag noise (ix:hidden metadata on source line 1) excluded from evidence.
annotation_methodology.scoring_method: Five-dimension weighted scoring (D1 0.25 / D2 0.20 / D3 0.20 / D4 0.20 / D5 0.15), 1-5 integer scale per dimension, anchored to confirmed META 2023 benchmark (4.0) and validated GOOGL 2023 sample (4.25)
annotation_methodology.human_verification: All text excerpts and financial figures transcribed verbatim from the 10-K body text at the cited section+locator positions; cross-checked MD&A vs Notes vs Statements for consistency (revenue, net income, capex, depreciation, PP&E detail all internally consistent)
annotation_methodology.limitation: Single-year 10-K. (1) Useful lives disclosed as ranges only; no per-asset-class assignment, so D1 scoring relies on upper bounds. (2) 'Dojo' does not appear anywhere in this filing; Tesla's AI training compute exposure is inferred from Item 1 'additional computer hardware' language and the +83% growth of the 'Computer equipment, hardware and software' PP&E class - the exact depreciation life applied to AI training assets is unobservable. (3) Amortization and any small impairments are not separately disclosed (combined CF line $4,667M). (4) 2023 net income is distorted by the $5.93B one-time tax benefit; operating-income-based ratios preferred.
